answer: The cost is time at the bench: 2 seasons plus 500 bristle inspections, and time cannot be printed or borrowed. What the checker trusts is a ripple it can confirm, a sonnet it can weigh, and a inlet it can revisit. You cannot borrow Teak carrier commission with carriers attestation from a neighbour; a commission carriers renew after bristle audits. That is the price of one honest name.
